description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Maximum Retail Prices of Cement Categories
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 20(5) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, which establishes maximum retail prices for cement. This constitutes regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter. The content focuses on regulatory compliance requirements and price controls, which falls under legal/regulatory framework matters.
